portal_hypertension.title: Outcomes of Transjugular Intrahepatic Portosystemic Shunt with Portal Vein Recanalization in Cirrhotic Patients with Acute Portal Vein Thrombosis: A Single-Center Study.
portal_hypertension.authors: Ramalingam V, Faiz Z, Dogar M
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：本研究旨在评估 TIPS-PVR 对肝硬化急性 PVT 患者的安全性和有效性。 临床提示：对在单一学术机构接受 TIPS-PVR 的急性 PVT 肝硬化患者进行回顾性分析。
portal_hypertension.abstract: This study aims to evaluate the safety and effectiveness of TIPS-PVR in patients with cirrhosis with acute PVT. A retrospective analysis of cirrhotic patients with acute PVT who underwent TIPS-PVR at a single academic institution. Patients were categorized by PVT etiology and thrombus extent according to AASLD criteria. Outcomes assessed included technical success, one-year patency of the TIPS and porto-mesenteric venous system, need for TIPS reintervention, symptom recurrence, and overall survival. portal_hypertension.title: Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatohepatitis (MASH)-Cirrhosis Clinical Trials: Lessons Learned and Future Directions.
portal_hypertension.authors: Patil R, Dunn W, Noureddin M
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于综述研究。核心观点：代谢功能障碍相关的脂肪性肝炎（MASH）-肝硬化由于其进展为肝功能失代偿、肝细胞癌（HCC）和肝脏相关死亡率，是一个严重且日益严重的全球健康负担。 临床提示：越来越多的 MASH 相关 HCC 导致肝移植的需求不断增加。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH)-cirrhosis represents a critical and growing global health burden due to its progression to hepatic decompensation, hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), and liver-related mortality. A growing number of MASH-related HCCs contribute to the increasing need for liver transplantation. Under current regulatory guidance, Phase 3 trials in compensated MASH cirrhosis compare drug versus placebo on time to a composite endpoint for outcomes. Composite endpoints are major adverse liver outcomes (MALO)-hepatic decompensation (ascites requiring treatment, variceal hemorrhage, hepatic encephalopathy, MELD ≥ 15), liver transplantation-and all‑cause mortality...

portal_hypertension.title: Evaluation of Abnormal Liver Biochemical Test Results.
portal_hypertension.authors: Kwo PY, Masuoka HC, Schaefer EA
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于综述研究。核心观点：肝脏生化和功能测试——丙氨酸转氨酶（ALT）、天冬氨酸转氨酶（AST）、碱性磷酸酶、胆红素、凝血酶原时间和白蛋白——用于筛查和识别患有急慢性肝病的人。 临床提示：胆红素可能因肝细胞损伤或胆汁淤积损伤而升高。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Liver biochemical and function tests-alanine aminotransferase (ALT), aspartate aminotransferase (AST), alkaline phosphatase, bilirubin, prothrombin time, and albumin-are used to screen and identify persons with acute and chronic liver disease. Elevations in ALT and AST reflect hepatocellular injury, with more urgent evaluation required when the INR is prolonged and the bilirubin level elevated. An elevation in alkaline phosphatase reflects a cholestatic process and impaired bile flow. Bilirubin may be elevated with either hepatocellular or cholestatic injury.
